name: InnerGS Volumetric Rendering
aliases: Factorized 3D Gaussian Splatting for Inner Scenes
definition: A scene representation that directly models volumetric density by calculating the contribution of each Gaussian to a pixel on a 2D slice at depth t, enabling synthesis of novel slices at arbitrary depths without relying on projection.
summary: InnerGS Volumetric Rendering synthesizes novel 2D slices at arbitrary depths using 3D Gaussians, avoiding standard splatting artifacts to enable seamless volumetric interpolation and internal structure reconstruction.
